name: Daily Order Sheet Report
query: SELECT ose.creation AS "Created On:Datetime:150", /* Style Image */ CASE WHEN ose.style_image IS NOT NULL AND ose.style_image != '' THEN CONCAT('') ELSE '' END AS "Style Image:HTML:120", ose.name AS "Order Sheet:Link/Order Sheet Entry:150", ose.production_factory AS "Factory:Data:100", ose.buyer AS "Buyer:Link/Customer:120", ose.style_name AS "Style:Data:150", ose.season AS "Season:Data:100", ose.color AS "Color:Data:100", ose.gauge AS "Gauge:Data:80", ose.construction AS "Construction:Data:150", ose.order_qty AS "Order Qty:Int:100", DATE_FORMAT(ose.shipment_date, '%%d-%%m-%%Y') AS "Shipment Date:Data:120", /* Yarn Aggregation */ GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT yd.yarn_composition) AS "Yarn Composition:Data:200", GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT yd.yarn_count) AS "Yarn Count:Data:120", /* Production Summary */ IFNULL(SUM(op.knit), 0) AS "Knit:Int:80", IFNULL(SUM(op.link), 0) AS "Link:Int:80", IFNULL(SUM(op.mending), 0) AS "Mend:Int:80", IFNULL(SUM(op.wash), 0) AS "Wash:Int:80", IFNULL(SUM(op.poly), 0) AS "Poly:Int:80", /* Production Balance */ (ose.order_qty - IFNULL(SUM(op.poly), 0)) AS "Balance:Int:100", /* Yarn DO Status */ CASE WHEN COUNT( CASE WHEN yd.do_number IS NOT NULL AND yd.do_number != '' THEN 1 END ) > 0 THEN 'In House' ELSE 'Waiting' END AS "Yarn Status:Data:100", /* Aging */ DATEDIFF(NOW(), ose.creation) AS "Days Since Created:Int:120", DATEDIFF(NOW(), ose.shipment_date) AS "Days to Shipment:Int:120" FROM `tabOrder Sheet Entry` ose LEFT JOIN `tabOrder Sheet Yarn Detail` yd ON yd.parent = ose.name LEFT JOIN `tabOrder Sheet Production` op ON op.parent = ose.name WHERE ose.docstatus < 2 /* Buyer Filter */ AND ( IFNULL(%(buyer)s, '') = '' OR ose.buyer = %(buyer)s ) /* Factory Filter */ AND ( IFNULL(%(factory)s, '') = '' OR ose.production_factory = %(factory)s ) /* Start Date Filter */ AND ( IFNULL(%(start_date)s, '') = '' OR DATE(ose.creation) >= %(start_date)s ) /* End Date Filter */ AND ( IFNULL(%(end_date)s, '') = '' OR DATE(ose.creation) <= %(end_date)s ) GROUP BY ose.name, ose.creation, ose.style_image, ose.production_factory, ose.buyer, ose.style_name, ose.season, ose.color, ose.gauge, ose.construction, ose.order_qty, ose.shipment_date ORDER BY ose.shipment_date ASC, ose.creation DESC;
